pages.text: Crops can grow on rain alone!$(br2)Once the current rain has lasted at least $(thing)minRainHours$() (default 12 in-game hours), exposed crops - not under a roof or tree canopy - count as watered.$(br2)They grow normally and their thirst timer resets.

pages.title: Details
pages.text: A vanilla storm lasts about 12-24 in-game hours, so with the default 12 the second half of a rain feeds your crops.$(br2)Snow does not count as rain, and places with a roof or leaves block the rain.$(br2)Only dimensions with skylight (the overworld) participate.
